title: It Takes Two
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball. Reported by david0ha (highball-db#361, 2026-10-06), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.3, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, the environment in DXMT mode, rated 5 of 5 after 109 minutes; see also highball-db#216. alex-jke (highball-db#455, 2026-10-11), Apple M1 Pro with 16 GB, macOS 15.7.4, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXMT with msync, rated 5 of 5 after playing it start to finish in online co-op, hosting from the Mac with the game bought while a friend on a Windows PC joined through the Friend's Pass (clarified on the issue), about 57 to 63 fps at 1080p on the default preset.
notes: Works on DXMT. A player on an M1 Pro with 16 GB and macOS 15 finished the whole game in online co-op, hosting a friend on a Windows PC who joined through the Friend's Pass, at about 57 to 63 fps at 1080p on the default preset. An occasional 'Unable to connect to the EA Servers' message kicked them out, which Windows players see too. Joining from a Mac as the Friend's Pass guest is untested.
